{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Fried Bananas Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Fried Bananas Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoI |cost= |value= |location= |uses= Restoring [[Heart]]s |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Fried Bananas''' are recurring [[Item]]s and [[Object]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Fried Bananas|Fried Bananas|Series, BotW, TotK}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} }} |- | ''No name is given'' | {{AoI}} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Fried Bananas are [[Meal]]s made by [[Cooking]] [[Mighty Bananas]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], and [[Cane Sugar]]s together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can only be made by adding a fourth ingredient that is a [[Fruit]] or vegetable without the Mighty effect. Eating them will restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. Children are known to love this dish, and the trick to make them is to fry the Bananas over very high heat. ''[[Misa's Recipe Book]]'', which can be found at [[The Slippery Falcon]] in [[Rito Village]], contains a recipe for Fried Bananas. [[Misa]] first instructs the reader to buy Tabantha Wheat and Cane Sugars from her store. Next, she says to fry them with Mighty Bananas, though she comments on their rarity around Rito Village. Only one variation of Fried Bananas exist: * '''Mighty Fried Bananas''': Made by only using the base three ingredients. When consumed, they temporarily increase the power of Link's attacks. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Only one variation of Fried Bananas exist: * '''Mighty Fried Bananas''': Made by only using the base three ingredients. When consumed, they temporarily increase the power of Link's attacks. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoI|-}}=== As part of the [[Quest]] "[[Goin' Bananas]]", [[Calamo]] discovers that all of the [[Mighty Bananas]] in the [[Faron Woods]] have been knocked from their [[Tree]]s, and he decides to make Fried Bananas so they do not go to waste. After he does so, he has too many to eat on his own, so he shares them with a group of [[Hylian Soldier]]s. The Soldiers reward Calamo by allowing him to join their training session. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bananas * Meal * Mighty Bananas * Roasted Mighty Bananas }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Fried Bananas}}

Looks like some monsters went n' knocked all the bananas off the trees in the Faron Woods. It'd be a real shame if they went to waste...so how 'bout we make some fried bananas?

Phew! I fried way too many bananas, so I ended up givin' most of 'em to some Hylian soldiers—who all walked away from the meal feelin' plenty refreshed. They paid me back by lettin' me join 'em in a trainin' session, and I even learned a little somethin' outta it!
